name: Painted Tree Boutiques - Frisco
summary: Painted Tree Boutiques in Frisco is an innovative marketplace featuring hundreds of independent shop owners offering curated home décor, fashion, and gifts under one roof. This unique boutique collective provides a treasure-hunt shopping experience where visitors can discover artisan products and support small businesses in a convenient, single location.
demographics: Painted Tree Boutiques in Frisco attracts a predominantly female demographic aged 25-55 with middle to upper-middle income levels, reflecting Frisco's affluent suburban character. The trade area serves families in one of the fastest-growing cities in Texas, with household incomes well above the national average and a strong preference for unique, boutique-style shopping experiences. Visitors are typically homeowners seeking curated home décor, fashion, and gifts rather than mass-market retail, with shopping patterns favoring weekend browsing and discovery of artisan and small-business products.
description: Painted Tree Boutiques in Frisco, Texas offers a unique shopping experience that reimagines the traditional retail model by bringing together hundreds of independent shop owners under one roof. Located at 2930 Preston Road in the heart of Frisco's thriving retail corridor, this innovative marketplace features an ever-changing collection of boutique shops specializing in home décor, fashion, and gifts. Each shop owner curates their own space, creating a treasure-hunt atmosphere where visitors can discover new favorites around every corner, from handcrafted furniture and vintage finds to contemporary fashion and artisan gifts. The 152 customer reviews averaging 4.5 stars reflect the community's enthusiasm for this fresh approach to shopping, where supporting small businesses meets the convenience of a single destination. Open Monday through Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM and Sundays from 11 AM to 6 PM, Painted Tree Boutiques has become a beloved destination for Frisco residents and visitors seeking one-of-a-kind items and a more personal shopping experience.
